product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides real-time text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and voice-agent APIs and tools for businesses and developers building voice experiences at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its enterprise voice platform and TTS, STT, and voice-agent APIs.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Pay as you go and Enterprise pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in customer stories/case studies.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook search result reports 60 total employees, which falls in this band.

hq_location.notes: Company press kit gives a San Francisco, California headquarters address.

founded_year.notes: The company founder's official author profile says Smallest AI was started in 2023.

eng_blog.notes: Smallest AI Team is identified as its Text to Speech Team conducting model R&D, and its author page lists technical posts on model integration and TTS evaluation—multiple posts on infrastructure/model development.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple articles, product/API information, integration guidance, and FAQs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board shows three openings across Engineering and Finance; indexed titles include Senior SDET, Software Engineer - Systems and Reliability, and Manager - Finance and Accounts. None has an AI/ML/data-science title matching the stated criteria.

model_provider.value: Smallest.ai's own Electron V2 small language model; OpenAI is listed for LLM inference for specific features/tooling/evaluation.
model_provider.notes: The company describes Electron V2 as its own LLM, and its security subprocessor information names OpenAI for limited LLM inference uses.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center publicly names all five certifications/compliance claims; this reports claims as named there.

last_funding.notes: The latest disclosed round was a $13 million Series A announced July 31, 2026; the company also published its announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 Series A was within the 18 months preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists three openings in Engineering and Finance, with no SDR, BDR, sales representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced the Shopify + Atoms voice order-status and returns feature on October 30, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company press kit identifies co-founders Sudarshan Kamath (CEO) and Akshat Mandloi (CTO); the official profile dates the company's start to 2023. No C-level/VP join or departure within the 12-month window was identified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public documentation explicitly says Salesforce integration is available; HubSpot is described as coming soon, so it is not counted as a currently available stack integration.
